vocabulary.definition: to mix two liquids together that do not normally mix
vocabulary.example: The recipe calls for slowly adding the oil to the vinegar while whisking to emulsify the dressing.

vocabulary.definition: a localized physical condition in which part of the body becomes reddened, swollen, hot, and often painful, especially as a reaction to injury or infection
vocabulary.example: After the surgery, there was some inflammation around the wound which the doctor treated with medication.

vocabulary.definition: a thick mass of coagulated liquid, especially blood, or a similar mass
vocabulary.example: The medication helps prevent the formation of blood clots in patients at risk of heart attacks.

vocabulary.definition: to make someone more likely to suffer from a particular condition or to do a particular thing
vocabulary.example: Due to her family history, she was predisposed to developing diabetes later in life.

vocabulary.definition: a thread or filament from which a vegetable tissue, mineral substance, or textile is formed
vocabulary.example: Eating foods rich in fiber, such as whole grains and vegetables, can help improve digestion.

vocabulary.definition: treatment intended to relieve or heal a disorder
vocabulary.example: The doctor recommended a combination of physical therapy and medication as part of the patient's treatment therapies.
